faqs.a:
Notice of hearings under this article shall be served upon parties in accordance with
               the following:
(1)
In all cases in which the parties have submitted their address to the agency in the
                  course of licensing proceedings or otherwise, notice shall be mailed by first-class
                  mail to the last such address submitted.
(2)
In all other cases notice shall be delivered by personal service, unless other service
                  is approved by the hearing officer.
(3)
Except where a license or permit has been temporarily suspended pending the hearing,
                  notice shall be delivered not less than ten days prior to the hearing.
(4)
In the case of board of adjustment, liquor licensing authority and such other hearings
                  as may by ordinance require posting, publication or other notice to the public, such
                  notice shall be provided in addition to the notice herein provided to parties.
(Code 1981, § 2-139; Ord. No. 3608, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2003)
